lessons.trigger_condition: External TCG apps and open-source scanners consistently separate condition, language/edition, printing, evidence type, seller/source provenance, and dated price history, while the tablet already had much of the underlying identity logic but did not expose it coherently in the multi-market/card-measurement UI.
lessons.prevention_rule: Reuse canonical condition and edition contracts, require explicit condition/printing evidence for headline recommendations, preserve seller/store only when providers supply it, expose completed/API/asking tiers separately, and keep bounded device-only lookup history clearly distinct from official transaction history.
validation_required: NM/LP/MP/HP/DMG filters reuse the canonical repository allowlist and fail closed on unknown or mismatched condition evidence
printing filters and existing region/language-edition selector remain exact and cannot infer evidence from search terms
seller/store provenance is preserved only from structured provider evidence and public source links remain visible
completed-sale, API-reference and asking/listing source medians can be viewed independently without changing recommendation tier selection
device-only recommendation history is bounded, same-day deduplicated, clearly labeled as local lookup history, and has no cloud upload path
card grading cockpit carries condition, printing, freshness and seller context from the same verified market result
tcg-condition-language-pricing, tcg-seller-provenance and tcg-local-price-history are mirrored and routed
full tablet runtime, integrity, sync, SELFREFINE, CodeQL and collection guards pass before merge
lessons.safety_boundary: No missing condition, printing, seller, sale, price, grade, stock or market direction is invented. Social/search research remains discovery-only. Local history is not described as official sales history, non-core grading stays disabled, and physical tablet verification remains separate.
